verdict.rationale: Postman's docs say the Postman CLI can check API specifications against configured API governance rules. The release notes add that the CLI can lint API schemas and run security and governance checks, which covers the core of the story. Evidence is limited to brief one-line claims. Missing for 10: documentation of how style and governance rulesets are authored or customized (e.g. custom rule definitions, severity levels), explicit style-rule support beyond governance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
